_safety_note: SINGLE-LAYER write protection, unlike meta-ads.json. This server has no write-disable switch (compare META_ADS_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS there), so all 8 write tools — including send_dm, which messages real customers — are registered and callable. The read_only_tools split below is the ONLY thing keeping them behind a permission prompt. Do not add a wildcard grant for this server.

INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Long-lived Meta Graph API access token for an Instagram Professional (Business or Creator) account. Long-lived tokens expire after ~60 days; refreshing is an operator-side Graph API call — this server has no refresh path. DM tools additionally require the instagram_manage_messages permission, which is Advanced Access and only granted after Meta App Review. Gitignored — never commit; store only in the fleet .env.

INSTAGRAM_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Numeric id of the Instagram Professional account this bot acts for. Mapped to the server's own INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_ID env var. Not a secret, but fleet-specific — it identifies a real account, so it belongs in the fleet .env rather than a committed file.
